description: This file defines a PHP class 'WorkShiftSearchFilterParams' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Dto'. It extends a base class 'FilterParams' and sets a default sort field for work shift searches in an HR management system. The class also includes a constant defining allowed sorting fields.
